segments.speaker: Anita
segments.text: Welcome everyone. The goal of this meeting is to plan the next sprint for the analytics dashboard.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: The data pipeline is behind schedule because the warehouse credentials were delayed.

segments.speaker: Anita
segments.text: We have decided to postpone the export feature to the following sprint.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: I will fix the ingestion script by Thursday.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: I'll prepare the chart mockups and share them by next Monday.

segments.speaker: Anita
segments.text: We will use PostgreSQL for the reporting database instead of SQLite.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Who will handle the user acceptance testing is still undecided.
